text:
maya_sec: 🚨 heads-up: noticed uploader logs `unencrypted object` for tenant-72 during nightly backups (05:03 UTC). S3 PUT returned 200 but metadata has `x-encrypt: false`. Anyone touching RBAC or KMS grants?
liam_eng: I ran the RBAC prune last night around 04:30 UTC. Could have clipped a grant. Looking now.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-23-enc-upload, severity: P2 — channel #inc-2026-03-23 created.
oliver_ops: quick check: backup-uploader release rolled at 04:50 (v2.1.0 -> v2.2.0). v2.2.0 introduced a new SSE header flow.
jess_storage: from object listing: affected objects lack our `cipher-version` metadata and `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header. KMS rejects on re-encrypt attempt: `AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt` in logs.
maya_sec: Is this limited to staging or hit prod as well? We need scope.
liam_eng: seeing entries in both staging and prod buckets. First prod hit 05:03, last seen 05:22.
oliver_ops: mitigations proposed: 1) pause uploader fleet, 2) set bucket ACLs to private immediately, 3) stop replication. I can do 1+2 now.
maya_sec: do it. Also start export of CloudTrail/CloudAudit logs for 04:00-06:00 UTC and snapshot KMS Audit logs. We need audit evidence for customers and compliance.
oliver_ops: paused jobs at 05:25 UTC and set ACL to private. Replication paused.
liam_eng: rollback RBAC prune: re-grant `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:Encrypt` to service account `backup-uploader@infra`. Applying now.
jess_storage: after RBAC rollback, re-run uploader health check -> uploader now sends SSE headers on new uploads. Verified new object has `x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms` and `cipher-version: v1`.
liam_eng: creating a short-lived ephemeral KMS grant to allow re-encryption of affected objects (will audit). Grant created with 1-hour TTL.
jess_storage: re-encrypt job started at 05:42 UTC using ephemeral grant. Progress: 120 objects queued across three prefixes. Will log checksums.
maya_sec: comms: draft customer notice flagged — include timeline, proof-of-encryption checksums, and mitigation steps. Also open a post-incident action to add metadata presence checks pre-PUT.
liam_eng: follow-ups: add CI assertion for presence of `cipher-version` and SSE header; add a unit test for RBAC prune tool to avoid removing kms grants flagged in a whitelist.
oliver_ops: I'll add a canary to v2.2.0 to reject uploads without `cipher-version` header at agent-side rather than relying on later re-encrypt.
jess_storage: saved re-encrypt logs and checksums to /mnt/sec-audit/enc-reencrypt-1712348901.log. Will attach to incident.
maya_sec: assigning owners: remediation = liam_eng + jess_storage; comms = maya_sec; ops rollback verification = oliver_ops.
liam_eng: will follow up with PR referencing incident and include terraform whitelist for KMS grants. ETA for PR: EOD today.
maya_sec: thanks team. keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
